profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a highly skilled, analytical Senior Software Engineer with a proven track record translating business requirements and functional specifications into logical program designs, code modules, stable application systems, code standards, and writing specs.

I’m passionate about creating innovative, successful solutions to complex problems.

One accomplishment I’m proud of occurred at FairPoint Communications. Addresses contained in various ERP systems were not automatically synchronized. Management asked me to create a solution. I led a team of 2 developers and a QA Analyst. We established a lightweight open source application architecture using Java and Spring running on Tomcat. We integrated enterprise systems via IBM DataPower message queues with asynchronous ETL processes. We saved the company millions of dollars in manual processes and error corrections and improved the customer experience by having correct addresses on all corporate correspondence.

Another achievement was with Compaq. They wanted a custom solution that would bring together Interactive Voice Response Systems, PeopleSoft, and Intranet self-service applications. A new adapter had just been released to integrate a web server with PeopleSoft. A proof of concept was needed to demonstrate our company's capability to meet the requirements. I was assigned to implement the POC. I developed an in-house prototype and worked on-site for a year collaborating with the customer’s development team to implement a solution. The application I created was presented to Compaq’s senior management. They bought the product with my application generating hundreds of thousands of dollars in billable hours and product sale.

I would welcome the opportunity to work with an organization that would utilize my business system analysis and design strengths while allowing me to collaborate to bring high-quality software products to market and advance to spend more time performing architecture analysis and design.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Conduct extensive research on integrating JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication for REST calls in a Spring Boot application, focusing on enhancing security and scalability.
* Develop a comprehensive proposal outlining the transition from basic authentication to JWT-based authentication for WebClient requests, emphasizing the need for improved security and system maintainability.
* Implement a prototype demonstrating the feasibility and effectiveness of proposed solution, ensuring alignment with the project's goals and scope.
* Implement proposed solution, streamlining the authentication process. implementing integration testing and aspect oriented programming to address cross cutting requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Agile Application Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · RESTful architecture · Git · RESTful WebServices · Jira · Microservices · Spring Boot

positions.title: Spring Boot Developer
positions.locationName: Manchester, New Hampshire, United States · Remote
positions.description:
* Establish a framework for the the company to build secure RESTful APIs. Engaged in architecture, design and construction of for secure access using the OAuth2 Client Credentials flow. Delivered a Spring Boot module that accesses internal repositories to securely share customer data.
* Extend the company's Single Sign-On and Google API Integration. Developed prototype code to enable logging into our application with Google Credentials. Upon login, relevant data is pulled from Google Classroom with the Google API's library using the OAuth2 Authorization Flow. Worked with the team transforming the prototype into a new product feature.
* Participate as a remote developer on an agile team. Implement product enhancements for SAML SSO Login, batch processing and API integration with Learning Management Systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Agile Application Development · Apache Kafka · Docker Products · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · RESTful architecture · Git · RESTful WebServices · Software Lifecycle · Jira · Kubernetes · Microservices · Spring Boot

positions.title: Senior Application Developer / Architecture Committee
positions.description:
* Application development to support OSS/BSS telecommunications portal
* Technical leadership of medium and large complexity projects defining scope and level of effort
* Lead the review and implementation of new technologies, practices and architecture
* Mentor junior developers toward best practices
* Lead in Agile Sprint Planning and Daily Standups; work closely with Product Owners to understand requirements
* Assist with road-mapping key architectural initiatives
* Setting goals for architectural maturity
Participate in portfolio planning regarding application scalibality and stability
* Creating and maintaining the overall architecture of the application, database, supporting services and security
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Agile Application Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Persistence · Git · Software Lifecycle · Jira · Spring Boot

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
* Integrate disparate OSS/BSS systems using web services and message queues to synchronize systems
* Architecture and design for the development of Java applications within the Custom Development group
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical staff transforming requirements into software solutions that improve workforce productivity, reduce operational cost and streamline the flow of data between systems.
* Establish and maintain continuous build, configuration and deployment of Java artifacts to multiple environments.
* Reduce operational cost by migrating applications off proprietary WebLogic licences to open source Spring Boot services.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Persistence · Software Lifecycle · Spring Boot

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
Conducted requirements analysis, designed and implemented commercial software products. Wrote document requirements, functional and technical specifications then created and made compelling presentation. 
* Lead consultant responsible for defining development tasks, preparing project plan and delegating work to improve application performance and stability of Tyco's Retail Expert product.
* Enhanced security components, tested and deployed tasks for ENEA ElementCenter product. 
* Utilized JMeter to troubleshoot HSQL database performance issues; recommended database changes based on results; tuned connection until performance requirements were met.
* Created Ant scripts to generate installable zip file for deployment of web application; installed application as windows service.
* Installed and configured CentOS for testing product deployment in Unix environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Persistence · Software Lifecycle

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Collaborated with quality assurance, support, and documentation groups to deliver and maintain server-based software line. Designed and implemented solutions for Flex client, Spring Service Hibernate persistence layers of application running on Tomcat.
* Designed and implemented JUnit testing harness that enables functional testing from Excel spreadsheets to validate service layer of product.
* Derived detailed designs from product requirements and functional specifications.  
* Collaborated with dedicated team of Windows, UNIX, and Java developers to code, comment and unit test web application server software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design, develop, test and support applications to generate custom reports from Oracle Advanced Benefits and Oracle Account Receivables data sources coding in Java and PL/SQL for Fidelity Employer Services. Applications use JDBC, Ant and Log4j.
•	Work with the Business Group to provide development support, technical analysis and resolve to production issues with outbound extract files.
•	Responsible for design development and implementation of testing tools and processes for Extract Files created for external use. Test tools use Java and PL/SQL Packages.
•	Responsible for code and maintenance of the Financial Reconciliation Collections reporting application. Application uses Java, JDBC, Ant, Log4j and Oracle SQL.

positions.title: System Development Specialist
positions.description:
•	Design and development for the NH Department of Safety to convert systems from Mainframe to J2EE using WebLogic and Oracle with Connectors to IDMS Mainframes.
•	Design and developed solution to replace legacy mainframe data extract processes and job scheduling with Oracle Stored Procedures and J2EE components.
•	Created testing harness for a web application’s XML Interface and EJB Business Tier
•	Responsible for providing technical leadership, assigning work and managing the progress of contractors and junior developers. Report status to management and recommend action.
•	Work with users to gather requirements and then translate the requirements into technical design using CASE modeling tools to produce UML artifacts.
•	Design and develop prototype solutions to integrate web applications with credit card processing servers and legacy printers using J2EE components.
